Reject creating an owner whose telephone number is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
The implementation is complete and matches the acceptance criteria exactly.

## Summary

The spec required rejecting creation of an owner whose telephone is already used by **any other owner** (409).

**Change made** — `OwnerRestControllerV1.isDuplicateOwner` (`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):

The `addOwner` handler already returned `409 CONFLICT` when `isDuplicateOwner` was true, but the check matched on **last name + telephone** (a "household" rule from the prior checkpoint). I changed it to match on telephone alone across all owners:

```java
private boolean isDuplicateOwner(Owner owner) {
    return this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
        .anyMatch(existing -> Objects.equals(existing.getTelephone(), owner.getTelephone()));
}
```

**Test updates** (`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java`):
- `createOwnerSuccess` previously posted a new owner using seed owner Franklin's telephone `6085551023` and expected `201`. Under the stricter telephone-only rule that's now a genuine collision, so I moved it to an unused telephone (`6085550000`) — it still exercises the success path.
- Added `createOwnerDifferentLastNameSameTelephoneConflict` to lock in the new "any other owner" behavior (different last name, same telephone → 409), which the old lastName+telephone logic would have wrongly allowed.

**Verification:** full suite green — `Tests run: 263, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, including the `Cp03Tests` acceptance tests (`coreRejectsDuplicateTelephone`, `functionalityAllowsDistinctTelephones`). Only v1 exposes `addOwner`; v2 has no create endpoint, so no change there.
